title: Tiny Teamwork: The Last Spark
description: Escape a robot-ruled world in a solo or 2?4-player cooperative platformer. Share a room code, carry and rescue teammates, solve relays and survive three giant encounters across 15 city, forest and factory stages. Original anime comic panels tell the story between regions. The hardest challenge was synchronizing shared lives, physics and boss progression; shared simulation and independent-client tests keep the team together.
